proposition.claim:
On PDF pages 16–17 (printed 1284–1285), Definition 2.8 requires \[A\subset\mathbb R,\qquad 0\in A,\qquad
 T=\bigoplus_{\beta\in A}T_\beta,\qquad T_0\simeq\mathbb R,\] with a lower-bounded locally finite index set, Banach homogeneous spaces, and a triangular structure-group action. Definition 2.9 explicitly sets aside the usual analytic model bounds. Consequently, the absence of such bounds is not treated as a defect.

Equation reference: eq:printedA. On PDF page 17, \(\mathcal{PB}\) is the vector space of planar rooted trees with edge labels \(0,1,\ldots,n\). A zero label is represented by an undecorated edge. Each nonzero edge ends at a leaf; a vertex has at most one such decorated edge, and that edge is rightmost. On PDF page 18 (printed 1286), the specified index set is \[
 A=\{0\}\cup_i\alpha_i\mathbb N
       \cup_i(\alpha_i\mathbb N-1),\] and the degree of a tree is the sum of \(1\) for every undecorated edge and \(\alpha_i-1\) for every edge decorated by \(i\). The formula is visible in the original PDF; it is not an extraction substitution for an additive sum of sets. No reciprocal-integer or nonresonance restriction on the positive regularities is imposed in this construction. The preceding rough-path definition permits regularity parameters in \((0,1]\) (PDF pages 10–11).

Lemma 3.5, on PDF page 20, asserts that \((A,\mathcal{PB},G)\) is a regularity structure. Its proof assumes that the indicated degree makes \(\mathcal{PB}\) an \(A\)-graded space, then checks triangularity. The following counterexamples test this algebraic assertion. They require no stochastic sample, numerical solver, or extra assumption about a particular rough-path lift. In particular, the time-augmentation and integration condition (17), introduced for the later model, cannot remove basis trees from the already declared space in Lemma 3.5.

Lemma 3.5 asserts that (A,PB,G) is a regularity structure with the page 18 index union and edge-sum degree.

one nonzero label. alpha_1=3/5 allowed positive regularity. rooted chain with edge labels 0,0,1. only nonzero edge ends at a leaf and is rightmost. include alpha_0=1 if time belongs to index union.
